# `get_user_log`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Package the diagnostic log files into a ZIP and return it as a binary transfer.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (strict; native handler, 64-bit build) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x1f0f40 (64-bit build) |

Registered in the imager file table of both builds. The handler removes any previous user_log.* scratch archive through a shell command, zips the Autorun_Log*.txt files under the configured log path into user_log.zip, reads the archive and logs the transfer size. The reply is a binary payload via the endpoint's result writer, not an ordinary command-JSON reply; failures are textual. Params are not consumed.

Side effects: Runs shell commands that delete a previous scratch archive and create user_log.zip from the diagnostic logs under the configured log path; logs the transfer size. Likely a scratch/diagnostic effect (candidate B) but the shell and zip descendant set is not fully read, so tier D is retained.
